Terms of Use

Last updated: 20 October 2026 · For the RasoiOne apps and rasoione.shop

In short: RasoiOne is paid for once, after a 7-day free trial of everything. The licence never ends. It includes 1 year of online services (table QR menu & orders, sync, app updates, WhatsApp support); after that they are optional, paid yearly. Billing and everything else keep working without them. There is no free plan: without a licence the app is read-only.

1. The service

RasoiOne is billing software for food businesses for Android, Windows and Mac, made by [Your business name]. By installing the app, starting a trial or paying you agree to these terms.

2. Free trial

  • Every new shop gets 7 days of everything free, once per mobile number and device. No payment details are asked.
  • After the trial, a licence is needed to make new bills. You can always open your bills, customers and reports, export them and take a backup, with or without a licence.

3. One-time licence

  • Plans (Dukaan, Restaurant, Restaurant + Desktop) are sold for a one-time price, for the number of devices stated in the plan. Prices are in Indian Rupees and include GST.
  • The licence does not expire. Billing, kitchen tickets, tables, khata, GST, loyalty, offers, reports, stock, staff, meal plans and backups keep working on your devices for as long as you use them, with or without internet and with or without online services.
  • There is no AutoPay and no automatic charge.

4. Online services (optional after the first year)

  • Online services are: the table QR menu and QR orders, phone ↔ computer and Google Drive sync, app updates, and WhatsApp support.
  • Every licence includes the first 1 year of online services (plus any referral bonus). After that you may renew them for one year at a time at the price shown in the app or on rasoione.shop (at launch ₹149 Dukaan, ₹199 Restaurant, ₹249 Restaurant + Desktop, ₹199 for Lifetime keys sold earlier). A renewal is added after the current end date, or from the day you pay if it has ended.
  • If you do not renew, online services pause 3 days after the end date. Nothing else stops and no data is deleted. You can renew later at any time.
  • App updates: features released while your online services are active are yours to keep forever. New paid features released after your online services end need a renewal. Security fixes are always free.
  • We may change prices. A new price applies only to purchases and renewals made after the change.

5. Licences sold earlier

  • Keys sold as monthly or yearly subscriptions before 20 October 2026 keep working until their paid-until date (plus 3 days). To continue, buy the one-time licence for the same key; your key, devices and data stay the same, and you get 1 year of online services from the day you buy. No new AutoPay mandates are created; you can stop an existing one any time in More → Plans.
  • Lifetime and Founding Shop licences bought earlier keep working forever, as sold, and can renew online services at the prices above.

6. Licence keys

  • Your licence key is created automatically and signed by us. It is for your own business. Do not share, resell or publish it. We may block keys that are misused.
  • You can move your licence to a new device yourself (once a month) or through support.

7. Where you buy

In the RasoiOne app downloaded from rasoione.shop (Android APK, Windows, Mac) and on rasoione.shop, payment is by Razorpay. The Google Play version does not sell anything inside the app; there you start the free trial or enter a key bought on rasoione.shop or from an authorised dealer. If we sell through the Google Play or Apple App Store, that store's terms apply to that purchase.

8. Referral programme

  • A new shop buying its first licence with a valid referral code gets 30 extra days of online services (or the bonus shown at checkout).
  • Referrers earn a commission on the new shop's first payment (10% for shops, or the rate agreed in writing with dealers), paid by UPI, normally within 15 days after the 7-day refund window ends.
  • No commission is paid on refunded, fraudulent or self-referred purchases. We may change or end the programme; commissions already earned are still paid.

9. Your data and responsibilities

  • Billing data stays on your device. Keep backups (the app can back up to your own Google Drive).
  • You are responsible for the correctness of your bills, prices, GST and tax filings. RasoiOne is a tool and does not give tax or legal advice.
  • Record customer details only with their consent and follow the DPDP Act, 2023.
  • Orders from the table QR are suggestions until you accept them; your bill in the app is the final bill, always at your own prices.
  • Swiggy and Zomato figures in the app are estimates from the rates you enter; your payout statement from the app is final.

10. Acceptable use

Do not try to break, crack, overload or misuse the apps, the licence server or rasoione.shop.

The software is provided "as is". To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for indirect losses such as lost profit or lost data. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.

13. Changes and termination

We may update these terms; the date above will change. You can stop using RasoiOne at any time. We may suspend licences used in breach of these terms.
